codex.resume_invocation_only_override: check_for_update_on_startup=false preserves the original projection ref

supported_settings: Swarm-generated launch hooks including SessionStart and StopFailure observers

unsupported_sources: Claude ambient HOME/XDG Anthropic OAuth profile stores
cohort_preservation: Claude selected-project trust and MCP configuration
source_profile_aliases: Original ambient profiles may use owned symlink aliases to a canonical owner-controlled directory; alias targets and identities are revalidated. Bound account profiles and source files reject symlinks.
claude_availability_check_gate: Linux-only, personal native OAuth identity/version required by caller, private selected profile and empty scratch directory, no custom or managed policy/cache sources, exact model without fallback, safe mode plus empty settings/tools/MCP and disabled skills. This gate reads configuration only; a live model request is separate.
claude_availability_runtime_history: Private native projects directories with inert transcript JSONL and sessions-index.json data are allowed without opening content: at most 4096 entries, eight nested path separators, 64 MiB per file and 512 MiB total. Unknown, executable, writable-by-others, special or symlink artifacts refuse. This is not a broad native cache allowlist.
claude_availability_metadata_backups: Pinned 2.1.288 static global-config readers Kc/Qc only print manual cp restoration suggestions for backups; they never parse them as fallback. Writer ll retains five .claude.json.backup.<epoch-ms> files. Permit only that inventory with owner-private non-executable regular files, no hardlinks/symlinks, at most 1 MiB each. Native 0775 backup directories remain confined by an owner-private 0700 profile; the gate never reads backup content or rewrites permissions. Characterization used public installed executable bytes and parent-reported auth-status artifact metadata; no model request.
claude_remote_policy_gate: Pinned native remote eligibility excludes known personal native OAuth pro/max plans unless profile-store or API-key authentication activates another route. Caller verifies the current personal plan; environment and profile inventory reject alternate sources. The public native remote-path override function is a no-op and is not used.
remaining_release_gate: Live native effective model, permissions, hooks, MCP, skills and trust precedence and native config rewrite acceptance; help parsing does not prove those behaviors.
